policy.updates: Exact reviewed pin changes only; aged at least seven days, or a documented exact-version urgent security exception. No floating latest at install/build/publish time.
policy.npm: Release-only CLI; use an explicitly selected supported, aged version >=11.15.0. The npm major is independent of the pnpm major.

pnpm.selection_reason: Official release notes describe executable-shim and credential-link hardening, frozen-install cleanup, and update/lockfile fixes. The release date is more than seven days before the handoff check date; registry timestamp and downloaded artifact verification remain required before bootstrap.

requirements: Verify actual registry publication timestamps/integrity for pnpm/npm and platform-specific pnpm binaries or installer dependencies.
Verify official Node binary checksums/signatures for the chosen platform.
Record tools actually executed and check version output.
Review advisories and release notes; age alone does not certify safety.
